whyThisMatters:
Kraft is an Irish shop that sells websites and search work, mostly as retainers. The founder says so on the listing. It is not a seat you log into. It is a packaged service that bills every month. The company dates to 2020. Ten subscriptions sit on the Stripe record, and the cash in a recent month is higher than that monthly figure, which fits project work landing next to the retainers.

The all-time total is the long part of the story. Years of websites and local search, paid through Stripe. The listing is for sale. The asking price is a few times one year of recent cash, not a startup multiple. The public site did not load when I looked, so this note stays with the listing. I am not inventing a client list or a town.

You pay a local shop so the website and the Google listing are someone else's Tuesday.
